row:
Hi I'm Tamsin and I am a practicing sports massage therapist with over 20 years experience and have been teaching for 15 years. The videos on my channel are part of the material I use while teaching sports massage courses. I hope you find them useful whether you are training, qualified or just interested. 
I believe in sharing knowledge so you can benefit from my years of experience working in different areas of sports massage including, working as part of a multi-disciplinary team, working with professional athletes, having my own business and everything else in between. 
At the School of Sports Massage we offers accredited Active IQ level 3 and 4 sports massage qualifications, we only work in small class sizes (4) enabling you to get the most from your time with the tutor,  we offer partly flexible learning making it easier to fit in around your life while. We also offer 1 to 1 tailored refreshers for anyone qualified who wants to remind themselves of skills or hone their practice.
